about_the_game:
Day Train is a “work background game” designed to help you stay focused while working or studying.
With its soothing, minimalist design and a UI optimized for productivity, it helps reduce the stress of daily tasks.

A Constantly Changing Real-Time Background

The background scenery in Day Train continuously evolves in real time.
The view from the window is automatically generated, ensuring that you never get bored, even during long sessions.
Additionally, the in-game time syncs with real-world time, offering new visual experiences throughout the day.

A UI Designed for Productivity

The game includes built-in task management and timer features.
It not only provides a relaxing atmosphere but also actively supports your workflow.

Customizable Sounds

The background music in Day Train can be customized by adding music files from your local PC, allowing you to create the perfect ambiance for concentration.
